subject: Vendor billing: preferred submission path & sample invoice layout
messages:
From: Clara Mendez <billing@lumensupply.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@lumensupply.com
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: LumenSupply billing - portal vs email + sample rows

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for taking onboarding with us. Were finalizing our billing flow and want to confirm Redwoods preferred invoice submission channel. A couple quick constraints from our side:
- Our AP team currently exports invoices from their ERP to CSV and sends them via SFTP, but some vendors email PDFs.
- If we use the portal, our team needs a CSV schema to map ERP fields to the contract PO.
- We also need to confirm the PO stamping rules (does Redwood accept multiple POs on one PDF/email?).

Attached is a small sample CSV and a one-page sample invoice PDF. Can you confirm:
1) Preferred channel: portal upload (CSV), SFTP drop, or email to billing inbox?
2) Minimal required fields and the header names in your ingest (we can adapt ERP export).
3) How you prefer to handle multi-PO invoices (separate files vs single file with line-level PO).

Goal: avoid rework during our first go-live batch.

Thanks,
Clara Mendez
Billing Lead, LumenSupply Inc.
attachment: Lumen_sample_invoice.csv (CSV)
attachment: Lumen_PO_sample.pdf (PDF)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Clara Mendez <billing@lumensupply.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: LumenSupply billing - portal vs email + sample rows

Hi Clara — thanks for the samples, very helpful. Short answers up front: portal-first, SFTP for larger partners, email fallback for one-offs. Details below and a couple of asks so we can sign off quickly.

Portal (preferred):
- Upload CSV or XLSX via our vendor portal. We have an import template (headers must match exactly for automated mapping).
- If you can export CSV from ERP, use the template well provide and we can ingest without manual intervention.

SFTP (secondary):
- Secure SFTP drop is fine for batch nightly deliveries. Must include filename convention: Redwood_<vendor>_<YYYYMMDD>.csv

Email (fallback):
- We accept PDF invoices via billing@redwood.com if you cannot use portal/SFTP. PDFs require manual QA and slower processing.

PO stamping / multi-PO handling:
- We prefer one PO per invoice file for deterministic matching. If you must include multiple POs on one invoice, include a line-level PO column in CSV; otherwise we may split items across multiple payment runs.

Required minimal fields (automation-friendly):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO 8601), vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, total_amount, currency, po_number (or line-level po_number), line_description, line_quantity, line_unit_price, line_net_amount, billing_contact_email

Action items for LumenSupply to avoid delays:
- Can you re-export the sample CSV with header names matching the list above?
- If using portal, confirm a primary onboarding user for our portal invite.
- If SFTP, share connectivity details and sample filename pattern.

Marissa will coordinate the portal invite and onboarding checklist; Vanessa will handle PO stamping edge cases and tax fields.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

We attached a revised CSV with header names closer to what you listed (see attached). A couple follow-ups after internal check:
- Our ERP will not export vendor_tax_id as a column by default — we can include company registration number or VAT number depending on country. Will Redwood accept either?
- For multi-PO shipments, the ERP produces a single invoice file with a line_item PO field; we can surface that as "po_number" in the line rows.
- On SFTP: we can set up a scheduled nightly drop. We need Redwoods SFTP host + account and preferred filename pattern.

Attachments: Lumen_sample_invoice_v2.csv

Thanks,
LumenSupply Onboarding Team

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 10:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: LumenSupply billing - portal vs email + sample rows

Thanks for the quick update and the v2 file. Couple clarifications from our side:
- Either vendor_tax_id or VAT/reg number is fine; we just need a consistent identifier. Please include the label youre sending so we can map.
- Line-level po_number is perfect for multi-PO invoices — thats our preferred approach.
- SFTP details: we'll open a ticket with SRE. For now, portal is easiest for validation during go-live; well provision an onboarding admin account for LumenSupply.

I've attached our import template (CSV headers only) and a short checklist for go-live validation:
1) Map CSV headers to template
2) Confirm sample of 3 invoices (CSV) processed without errors
3) Confirm PO matching and payment terms (NET 45 as per contract)

Vanessa, can you confirm tax-handling for cross-border invoices?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
attachment: Redwood_import_template.csv (CSV)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: LumenSupply billing - portal vs email + sample rows

Hi all — quick tax note: for cross-border invoices we need the VAT/reg number and currency column. If VAT isn't applicable, then vendor_tax_id (local registration) is acceptable. We'll require the tax identifier for any invoice > $5,000 for tax reporting.

Next steps (owners):
- LumenSupply: send the 3 sample CSVs mapped to the import template by Tue 11/20 (owner: onboarding@lumensupply.com).
- Redwood (Marissa): provision portal admin and share import template + test harness by EOD 11/17.
- Redwood (Jonas): confirm SFTP contact details if LumenSupply prefers nightly drops.

If we get the 3 successful test imports, we'll flip the vendor to portal-first and close the onboarding ticket.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
